title: PolicyRuleRef
description: One compiled Cedar policy and the document it came from.

id.description: The Cedar policy id, for example link/analyst-intern-to-market-data or action-policy/analyst-intern-actions/rule/2.

rule.description: ActionPolicy: the 1-based index of the rule; absent for the policy's default.

target.description: Whom the rule names: template:<name> (covering its clones) or clone:<name>.
